agent_ops.description: Report emitted only when at least one universal agent-ops flag ran (--fields, --filter-rows, --limit-rows, --sort-rows, --dedupe-by, --count-only, --truncate-content, --max-output-bytes). Absent on every untouched envelope, so a consumer that never passes those flags sees the exact previous shape. Every member is optional and only present when the corresponding operation produced something worth reporting.

total.description: Rows found in data before any row-scoped operation ran

matched.description: Rows surviving the row-scoped operations; compare against total to see how much was cut

truncated.description: True when --truncate-content cut at least one string; the only way to tell a short payload from a cut one

unresolved_paths.description: Dotted paths the caller asked for that no row (or the payload) carried. Without this an absent key is indistinguishable from a key that exists and is empty, and a sort or dedupe on a missing key reports matched == total, which reads as success.

flag.description: Which flag carried the path, so the caller knows which argument to correct

path.description: The path exactly as the caller typed it
